title: Return of Interest and Premium Charged on Earlier Premium: Stopped HECM Draw Checks
content:
**Clause.** Added to the compounding returned on a stopped Home Equity Conversion Mortgage (HECM) draw check is the interest and premium the monthly ledger charged on the stopped check's earlier premium, over the premium-correctable months — the accrual months charged but no more than 6 — with the monthly charge being the last applied rate plus the plan's annual mortgage insurance premium rate (0.50 percent on every HECM plan), divided by 1200. The last applied rate is the annual rate applied by the most recent interest accrual posted on the loan, or the note rate when none has posted.

**Tiers.**

- *More than 3 premium-correctable months:* the stopped check's amount multiplied by the following: one plus the monthly charge, raised to the power of the premium-correctable months, less one plus the last applied rate divided by 1200, raised to that same power, less the plan's annual premium rate divided by 1200 multiplied by the premium-correctable months.
- *At least 2 and no more than 3 premium-correctable months:* the stopped check's amount multiplied by the plan's annual premium rate divided by 1200, multiplied by the monthly charge, multiplied by the premium-correctable months, multiplied by the premium-correctable months less one, divided by 2.
- *Fewer than 2:* 0.00.

The figure is not rounded on its own.

**Input, judgement, output (hypothetical: a 10000.00 check, last applied rate 6.000 percent, premium rate 0.50 percent, monthly charge 6.50 divided by 1200).**

| Accrual months charged | Premium-correctable months | Tier | Figure |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | fewer than 2 | 0.00 |
| 3 | 3 | 2 to 3 | about 0.0677 |
| 6 | 6 | more than 3 | about 0.6579 |
| 10 | 6 | more than 3 | about 0.6579 |
